title: How to Cancel Nifty Subscription in 2026: Refunds, Pausing & More
summary: Learn how to cancel your Nifty subscription, how refunds and pausing work, what happens to your saved inventory, and why Vendoo offers more flexibility.
body_markdown:
To cancel your Nifty subscription


, log into your account, navigate to Settings > Subscription > Customer portal, and follow the cancellation instructions. Nifty does not offer prorated refunds or a traditional subscription pause feature, so understanding its billing policies is important before canceling.


This guide explains how to cancel Nifty, what happens to your inventory, and why switching to Vendoo may offer more flexibility for your reselling business.


## Main Takeaways


- **Cancellation:** You can cancel your Nifty subscription through the Customer portal in your account settings.


- **Support** : If your cancellation button disappears after scheduling a plan change, contact hello@nifty.ai for assistance.


- **No Pausing** : Nifty does not offer an indefinite billing pause, requiring sellers to cancel their subscription during extended breaks.


- **Refunds** : Nifty does not provide partial refunds for unused subscription time, although access continues until the billing period ends.


- **Inventory:** Canceling Nifty does not remove your active marketplace listings or automatically delete your saved inventory data.


- **Nifty Alternatives** : Vendoo offers volume-based pricing, broader marketplace support, and additional flexibility for sellers managing their monthly expenses.


## Step-by-Step: How to Cancel Your Nifty Account


Canceling a Nifty subscription is relatively straightforward


, provided you have access to the cancellation option in your account. In the Nifty Help Center, sellers can manage their subscriptions through an external customer billing portal.


Image Source: Nifty Help Center


### **How to cancel your Nifty subscription Step-By-Step** :


1. **Log in to Nifty** .


Visit Nifty and sign in to the account associated with your active subscription.
2. **Open Settings.** Navigate to the Settings section of your dashboard. ****
3. **Select Subscription.** Locate the Subscription option to access your current billing information and plan details. ****
4. **Open the Customer portal.** Click the Customer portal link to access the payment provider’s subscription management interface.


5. **Cancel your subscription.** Follow the prompts to cancel your plan and confirm your decision. ****
6. **Verify your cancellation.** Check that your subscription reflects the cancellation and save any confirmation for your records. ****


### **What If the Cancellation Button Is Hidden?**


Nifty users may encounter a frustrating issue when attempting to cancel their subscriptions: the cancellation button may disappear entirely after scheduling a plan change.


According to Nifty’s documentation, this happens when a seller has already scheduled a subscription adjustment, such as upgrading from the Bundle plan to the Automation plan. In these circumstances, Nifty’s third-party payment provider hides the cancellation option in the customer portal.


Nifty is aware of this issue, and yet they’re


*not fixing it.* This is straight from the Nifty Help Center.


Unfortunately, this means sellers cannot complete the standard cancellation process themselves.


If your cancellation button is missing, you have to send an email to hello@nifty.ai and request manual cancellation. Include your account email address, explain that you recently scheduled a plan change, and ask Nifty support to cancel your subscription before the next billing date.


Be sure to request written confirmation of your cancellation. Simply closing your account, removing a payment method, or abandoning the software does not guarantee that recurring charges will stop. ⚠️


### **Will Nifty Save Your Inventory After Cancellation?**


If you cancel Nifty, your items will stay actively listed.


However, Nifty does retain canceled users’ inventory data and drafts temporarily, but there is an important deadline.


According to its official cancellation policy, inventory data and drafts are deleted 30 days after the subscription ends.


If you reactivate within the applicable retention period, your previous inventory information should still be available. However, sellers who wait too long risk losing their saved data.


💡


**Tip:** Before canceling, consider saving copies of your product descriptions, photographs, inventory records, and other important information.


Remember that Nifty’s data retention policy is separate from your marketplace listings. Your published listings remain active on their respective marketplaces even if Nifty eventually deletes its stored inventory records.


## Refunds and Pausing: Nifty’s Strict Policies


Before canceling your Nifty subscription, it’s important to understand how the platform handles refunds, billing pauses, and inventory retention.


Nifty's subscription policies can affect how much money you save by canceling and how easily you can resume selling later…


- **No Partial Refunds:** Nifty does not offer prorated refunds for canceled subscriptions. If you cancel just two days into a 30-day billing cycle, you will not receive a refund for the remaining 28 days. However, you can continue using Nifty’s paid features until your current billing period expires.


- **No Long-Term Pausing:** Nifty previously lacked a convenient way for part-time resellers to temporarily suspend billing during slow months or vacations. However, its current documentation offers a free subscription pause of up to 90 days. Your subscription automatically resumes on your selected date, so it’s important to keep track of when billing will restart.


- **Data Retention** : Canceling your Nifty subscription does not immediately delete your inventory information. Nifty retains your saved inventory and drafts for 30 days after your subscription ends, allowing you to reactivate during that period without rebuilding your database. After 30 days, however, Nifty’s policy states that this data will be deleted. Your live marketplace listings remain unaffected.

## Cancel Nifty FAQs


### **How do I cancel my Nifty subscription?**


To cancel Nifty, log into your account, navigate to Settings, select Subscription, and follow the cancellation instructions. If the cancellation button is missing, contact hello@nifty.ai to request cancellation.


### **Does Nifty offer refunds if I cancel early?**


No. Nifty does not provide prorated refunds for unused subscription time. If you cancel shortly after your billing cycle begins, you will not receive a partial refund. However, you can continue using your paid features until the current billing period expires.


### **Can I pause my Nifty subscription instead of canceling?**


Yes. Nifty allows sellers to pause their subscriptions for up to 90 days. Your inventory data remains saved during the pause, and your subscription automatically resumes on your selected date. Contact Nifty support if you need a longer break.


### **Will I lose my listings if I cancel Nifty?**


No. Canceling Nifty does not remove your active listings on marketplaces like Poshmark, eBay, Mercari, or Depop. However, Nifty retains your saved inventory data and drafts for only 30 days after your subscription ends, so export or save important information before that deadline.


### **Is Vendoo cheaper than Nifty?**


Vendoo offers more affordable entry-level plans than Nifty. Vendoo's Starter plan costs $14.99 monthly or $12.49 per month with annual billing, while Nifty's crosslisting plans start at $39.99 monthly. Vendoo also supports 10+ marketplaces and offers a 14-day free trial, making it an attractive alternative for budget-conscious resellers
